startingCard.title: Donald Trump becomes president of the United States
startingCard.fact: Donald John Trump is an American politician, media personality, and businessman who is the 47th president of the United States.

cards.title: Khalifa International Stadium opens
cards.subtitle: Sports stadium
cards.fact: Khalifa International Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium located in Al Rayyan, Qatar, around 9 kilometres west from the centre of Doha.

cards.title: Kingdom of Iberia is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: In Greco-Roman geography, Iberia was an exonym for the Georgian kingdom of Kartli, known after its core province.

cards.title: Condor Flugdienst is founded
cards.subtitle: Airline
cards.fact: Condor, legally incorporated as Condor Flugdienst GmbH, is a German airline based in Neu Isenburg, Hesse.

cards.title: ‘The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Peter Jackson
cards.fact: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring is a 2001 epic fantasy film directed by Peter Jackson from a screenplay by Fran Walsh, Philippa Boyens, and Jackson.

cards.title: ‘Gangs of New York’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Martin Scorsese
cards.fact: Gangs of New York is a 2002 epic historical drama film directed by Martin Scorsese and written by Jay Cocks, Steven Zaillian, and Kenneth Lonergan, based on Herbert Asbury's 1928 book The Gangs of New York.

cards.title: Pedro de Valdivia dies
cards.subtitle: Spanish conquistador, first royal governor of Chile
cards.fact: Pedro Gutiérrez de Valdivia or Valdiva was a Spanish conquistador and the first Governor of Colonial Chile.

cards.title: Calvin Coolidge becomes president of the United States
cards.fact: Calvin Coolidge was the 30th president of the United States, serving from 1923 to 1929.

cards.title: Stridsvagn m/42 enters service
cards.subtitle: Type of medium tank
cards.fact: Stridsvagn m/42 was a Swedish medium tank in service in the World War II period.

cards.title: Nawaf Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah dies
cards.subtitle: Emir of Kuwait
cards.fact: Sheikh Nawaf Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah was Emir of Kuwait from 2020 until his death in 2023.

cards.title: Prometheus is created
cards.subtitle: Art Deco sculpture by Paul Manship
cards.fact: Prometheus is a 1934 gilded, cast bronze sculpture by Paul Manship, located above the lower plaza at Rockefeller Center in Manhattan, New York City.

cards.title: Hungry Howie's Pizza is founded
cards.subtitle: American pizza chain
cards.fact: Hungry Howie's Pizza & Subs, Inc., also known as Hungry Howie's Pizza, is a franchise and the 11th largest pizza chain in the United States, with over 550 locations.

cards.title: Duchy of Warsaw is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: The Duchy of Warsaw was a French client state established by Napoleon Bonaparte in 1807, during the Napoleonic Wars.

cards.title: Joan Crawford dies
cards.subtitle: American actress
cards.fact: Joan Crawford was an American actress.

cards.title: Grand Mosque is completed
cards.subtitle: Mosque in Kuwait City, Kuwait
cards.fact: The Grand Mosque, located in Kuwait City, is the largest mosque in Kuwait.

cards.title: UGM-73 Poseidon enters service
cards.subtitle: Two-stage solid-fuel nuclear-armed submarine-launched ballistic missile
cards.fact: The UGM-73 Poseidon missile was the second US Navy nuclear-armed submarine-launched ballistic missile (SLBM) system, powered by a two-stage solid-fuel rocket.

cards.title: Hideki Tojo becomes prime minister of Japan
cards.fact: Hideki Tojo was a Japanese military officer and politician who served as Prime Minister of Japan from 1941 to 1944 during World War II.

cards.title: First War of Scottish Independence begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The First War of Scottish Independence was the first of a series of wars between England and Scotland.

cards.title: ‘Finding Neverland’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Marc Forster
cards.fact: Finding Neverland is a 2004 biographical drama film about author and playwright J.M.

cards.title: ‘Top Gun: Maverick’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Joseph Kosinski
cards.fact: Top Gun: Maverick is a 2022 American action drama film directed by Joseph Kosinski and written by Ehren Kruger, Eric Warren Singer, and Christopher McQuarrie, from a story by Peter Craig and Justin Marks.

cards.title: Los Angeles Angels is founded
cards.subtitle: MLB franchise
cards.fact: The Los Angeles Angels are an American professional baseball team based in Anaheim, California, within the Greater Los Angeles area.

cards.title: Russian Republic is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: The Russian Republic was the short-lived Russian state which controlled, de jure, the territory of the former Russian Empire after its proclamation by the Russian Provisional Government on 1 September 1917 in a decree signed by Alexander Kerensky as Minister-Chairman and Alexander Zarudny as Minister of Justice.

cards.title: Chōkei becomes Emperor of Japan
cards.fact: Emperor Chōkei was the 98th emperor of Japan, according to the traditional order of succession.

cards.title: Mikhail Gorbachev wins the Nobel Peace Prize
cards.fact: Mikhail Sergeyevich Gorbachev was a Soviet and Russian politician who was the last leader of the Soviet Union from 1985 until the country's dissolution in 1991.

cards.title: Laozi dies
cards.subtitle: Semi-legendary Chinese philosopher, founder of Taoism
cards.fact: Laozi, formerly Latinized as Laocius, was a legendary Chinese philosopher considered to be the author of the Tao Te Ching, one of the foundational texts of Taoism.

cards.title: Celtic F.C. is founded
cards.subtitle: Football club
cards.fact: The Celtic Football Club, commonly known as Celtic, is a professional football club in Glasgow, Scotland.

cards.title: ‘Murder Is Easy’ is published
cards.subtitle: Book by Agatha Christie
cards.fact: Murder Is Easy is a detective fiction novel by Agatha Christie first published in the UK by the Collins Crime Club in June 1939, and in the US by Dodd, Mead and Company in September the same year under the title Easy to Kill.

cards.title: MacOS is released
cards.subtitle: Operating System
cards.fact: macOS is a proprietary Unix operating system, derived from OPENSTEP for Mach and FreeBSD, which has been marketed and developed by Apple since 2001.

cards.title: ‘Adblock Plus’ launches
cards.subtitle: Mobile app
cards.fact: Adblock Plus (ABP) is a free and open-source browser extension for content-filtering and ad blocking.

cards.title: Michelangelo dies
cards.subtitle: Italian artist and architect
cards.fact: Michelangelo di Lodovico Buonarroti Simoni, known mononymously as Michelangelo, was an Italian sculptor, painter, architect, and poet of the High Renaissance.

cards.title: ‘Uncharted: Drake's Fortune’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Naughty Dog
cards.fact: Uncharted: Drake's Fortune is a 2007 action-adventure game developed by Naughty Dog and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation 3.
